merges.summary: React + tldraw frontend: login, teacher and student dashboards, lesson page with AI-reconstructed editable boards (KaTeX math shape), recap panel, uploads, reminders UI. Verified in the browser against the mock-mode API. Self-reviewed; tsc and vite build clean.
FastAPI backend: auth, students, lessons, board uploads, Claude reconstruction and summaries (mock mode without a key), Telegram/Resend reminders. Self-reviewed; 12 tests passing, ruff clean.
